title: JAMMIN’ DJs Wedding 7/6/2011
author: madwire
excerpt: This was a beautiful wedding with a gorgeous backdrop in Genesee Georgia. Despite a chill in the air the positive emotions kept everyone warm.Once the ceremony concluded everyone moved indoors to finish out the night with dinner and dancing. Congratulations to Kevin and Hattie on a beautiful wedding! ~Bryan Evans
